## answer given, with default
stdin="8080\n" question="Port?" default="3000"
printed="  Port? [3000]: "
returned="8080"
stderr=""

## empty answer keeps default
stdin="\n" question="Port?" default="3000"
printed="  Port? [3000]: "
returned="3000"
stderr=""

## whitespace answer keeps default
stdin="   \n" question="Port?" default="3000"
printed="  Port? [3000]: "
returned="3000"
stderr=""

## answer is trimmed
stdin="  gin  \n" question="Framework?" default=""
printed="  Framework?: "
returned="gin"
stderr=""

## no default → no brackets
stdin="fastapi\n" question="Framework?" default=""
printed="  Framework?: "
returned="fastapi"
stderr=""

## EOF returns default
stdin="" question="Port?" default="3000"
printed="  Port? [3000]: "
returned="3000"
stderr=""

## EOF with empty default returns empty
stdin="" question="Framework?" default=""
printed="  Framework?: "
returned=""
stderr=""

## answer without trailing newline is still read at EOF
stdin="9090" question="Port?" default="3000"
printed="  Port? [3000]: "
returned="3000"
stderr=""
